text:
Each brings its own documents, customers
and conversations,
and none of that should ever cross over.

This is a multi-tenant AI customer support
platform.

A business adds its documents and website,
sets up a chatbot,
and embeds it on its own site.
Answers stream back with their sources,

and every conversation reaches a team
inbox.

This recording uses an offline demo model,
so the reply is a fixed sentence.

The retrieval, the streaming and the
citation behind it are real.

Underneath is a Next.js dashboard, a
FastAPI backend,

PostgreSQL with vector search, and Redis
driving background workers.

It is one modular monolith, running as
several processes in containers.
All seven now have passing local evidence,

backed by fifteen hundred and five passing
tests.

Real AI quality and production readiness
are still unproven.

Software engineering, full-stack
development and applied AI.

Read the full case study at venuja dot
online.
